cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Please sit; I'll look after you. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. One of ours. Let me save you a wasted journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have me, and I'm staying right here with you.

mechanism: A promises to manage dress retrieval and changes the offered help as the customer asks for increasingly precise depot information.
confusable: Unlike simply lacking an answer, A remains reassuring while each answer contains less about the dress.
comparison: Commercial retrieval and contact details differ from a parent comforting a suspended child.
seedUse: D141-b depot arrival and contact questions; S02-b adapts assistance while maintaining control of the interaction.
